_comment: Drift watchlist for the price-banded universe (re-normalized 2026-09-17, see universe_acct0.py). The detector is each industry's price mean/median ratio: watch above 1.20 or below 0.96, swap above 1.35 or below 0.93 (asymmetric: a price can rise without bound but only fall to zero). A defunct or halted ticker is swapped immediately. Do not download candidate data until a swap is performed with swap_symbols.sh.
